Package com.musemo.model

Class ArtifactModel

java.lang.Object
com.musemo.model.ArtifactModel
public class ArtifactModel extends Object
This class is used as a data model for an artifact in the museum. It is designed to encapsulate the data related to an artifact's attribute like id, name, type.

    • ArtifactModel

      public ArtifactModel()

    • ArtifactModel

      public ArtifactModel(int artifactId, String artifactName, String artifactType, String creator, String status, String origin, String condition, short floor, short roomNo)
      Class constructor used to create an artifact object with attributes.
      Parameters:
      artifactId - id of the artifact
      artifactName - name of the artifact
      artifactType - type of artifact like painting, sculpture,relic, fossil,others
      creator - name of the creator of artifact
      status - artifact status like permanent or temporary
      origin - place from where artifact originates
      condition - artifacts condition
      floor - floor where artifact is placed(1-5)
      roomNo - room where artifact is placed (1-7)
